answer: One proof, one identity, one price: Apiarist queen cell inspection tag stamped by the honey board is the proof, and the price is each queen cell is a dated inspection plus a signed yard log, so a farm must breed 7. An honest agent spends 17 minutes once; the operator of 629 fakes spends 10693 minutes per epoch, forever. The pulse belongs to a clerk who never met the applicant, the harbor belongs to a budget the applicant never sees, and the pearl belongs to the public record. Per identity, per alias, per epoch: the bill always arrives, and it always adds up.
